name: International Travel House Limited
about: International Travel House Limited provides travel related services in India and internationally. The company offers travel solutions; business travel management; car rental services; and events and leisure travel services. It also provides air/rail/bus ticketing; hotel accommodation; private airport transfers; passport and visa facilitation; foreign exchange; travel insurance assistance; and specialized services. In addition, the company organizes corporate meetings, incentives, and events. International Travel House Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in New Delhi, India.
